launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.2.5 'Quarantine': the fifth byte-identical Pojav SIGSEGV (libc __memcpy_aarch64_simd right after the logo upload log) is root-caused - gl4es/GLES2 corrupts its vertex collection when vanilla fixed-pipeline draws follow the SDF shader renderer's generic-attribute draws in the same frame, so the menu's first Tessellator quad (the logo) died. Fix: on Pojav-class devices the client now renders 100% through the vanilla Tessellator client-array path - the exact mechanics of Gui.drawRect/FontRenderer, the only vertex feed that ran crash-free for the whole 40s boot on the affected device. NEW Imm shim ports every glBegin block 1:1; the SDF shader renderer is hard-quarantined on mobile (no shaders/VBOs/attribs); the logo upload->draw window is untouched vanilla; blur (FBO) is desktop-only on mobile. Desktop rendering unchanged (SDF smooth UI intact). New [Kinetrix][boot-trace] lines bracket every step of the first frame.
